title: Model Shortlist Filter
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: DGX Evaluation for Textbook Generation
description: Apply four selection criteria, in order, to eight candidate models and name the first criterion each excluded model fails.

educational.topic: Selecting and Downloading an Open-Weight Model
learningObjectives: The learner will apply four selection criteria to 8 candidate models for a 128 GB unified-memory machine, deciding shortlist or exclude and naming the first failed criterion, with at least 7 of 8 correct.

pedagogical.teachingStrategy: Commit an answer, then see the correct answer and the reason
keyQuestions: Model D would load on this machine. Explain why it is excluded anyway.
commonMisconceptions: A model that fits in raw memory is acceptable.
A large context window makes up for a missing tool-calling feature.
A missing license statement is as good as a permissive one.
A popular name is proof of provenance.
assessmentOpportunities: Mastery is 7 of 8 correct on the first attempt.

chapter_title: Selecting and Downloading an Open-Weight Model
